messages.subject: how to embed downloadLinks correctly while rendering DataTable?
parts:
Hi Web Framework masters :),
For the past four days I have been trying to embed downloadLinks into DataTable (during the rendering phase of a DataTable),
so each downloadLink will invoke a different downloadHandler.

But unfortunately somehow I keep failing,
this is how my rendered table looks like, but the links do not work,downloadhandlers don't get invoked:


can somebody please tell me what am I doing wrong?

I posted my code in R-Fiddle: my code


Thank you for the help!

messages.author: 85e053d519f0f372
messages.subject: Re: how to embed downloadLinks correctly while rendering DataTable?
parts:
You need to tell Shiny that you have inputs in the table using
Shiny.bindAll(). Here is an example:
http://rstudio.github.io/DT/011-radio.html Your callback will not be
that complicated -- you only need

callback = JS("Shiny.unbindAll(table.table().node());
Shiny.bindAll(table.table().node());")

I also recommend you to use server = FALSE in DT::renderDataTable().

Regards,
Yihui
